text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: elevated 5xx rate observed from model-runner-prod (us-east-1). 15% error rate over last 5m. Auto-escalation to oncall.

lina_oncall: picking this up, oncall here. any immediate customer-facing alerts?

sam_support: seeing a spike in customer error counts and timeouts in the dashboard — most errors are 502/5xx gateway from the inference runtime. Affected customers: ~12 tenants, top impacted is internal-prod-test and partner-payments.

anna_sre: attaching quick traces, looks like worker processes crashing with OOM + segfaults. stack traces show heap fragmentation and repeated allocator failures.

mike_runtime: confirm — model-runner logs show repeated eviction loops in KV cache and then segfault in quant_attention kernel. sample log: ```
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] runner: evicting KV cache entry id=0x7fbe9e...
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] runner: allocate failed: cannot allocate 48MB
[2026-03-17T10:12:04Z] runtime: segfault at 0x0 in quant_attention.cu:142
```

jonathan_platform: are these all a single model variant or across variants?

mike_runtime: primarily affects quantized long-context variants (v2-q4a) on GPU nodes with >24k active KV entries. Non-quant variants are mostly OK.

lina_oncall: immediate mitigation options?

anna_sre: propose 3-step live mitigation: 1) route traffic away from affected GPU pool (us-east-1/gpu-pool-7) to fallback pool; 2) disable quant_attention kernel as hotpatch (forces reference kernel, less memory-frag); 3) throttle max batch size / reduce kv cache TTL.

lina_oncall: do we have a safe reroute command?

jonathan_platform: yes — run: ```
curl -X POST "https://ops-api.internal/reload-routing" -d '{"from":"gpu-pool-7","to":"gpu-pool-3","policy":"degraded-fallback"}'
```
I can execute if SRE wants.

mike_runtime: hotpatch to disable quant kernel: ```
rbctl kernels disable quant_attention --pool gpu-pool-7 --reason "live-oom-mitigation"
```
This will fall back to the slower attention kernel but should avoid the segfault.

lina_oncall: please run reroute now. jonathan_platform, pls run the kernel disable as soon as reroute is started.

jonathan_platform: running reroute now. response: 202 Accepted, change-id: reroute-4277-01.

mike_runtime: executing kernel disable, patch applied on pool agents. rolling restarts scheduled, will drain older worker pids.

devops-bot: autoscale action: adding 6 fallback instances in gpu-pool-3 (requested by jonathan_platform).

sam_support: quick customer update?

lina_oncall: sending short note to affected tenants: "We've detected elevated 5xx and timeouts tied to a runtime kernel issue. We've rerouted traffic and applied a temporary kernel fallback. You may see reduced throughput/latency while we stabilize. ETA ~30-45m."

anna_sre: monitoring telemetry — error rate dropped from 15% to 3% within 2m of reroute. KV evictions still visible on drained pool, but crashes stopped after kernel fallback.

mike_runtime: next steps: gather heap profiles from affected nodes, run leak/fragmentation repro, prepare a patch to quant allocator. also propose increasing KV-cache slice compaction frequency.

lina_oncall: assigning follow-up to oncall rotation handoff. I'll create an incident ticket and schedule postmortem: include heap dumps, kernel stack, list of affected model variants, and customer impact table.

sam_support: copying support ticket for the 12 tenants and adding remediation notes.

jonathan_platform: handoff: taking postmortem lead. lina_oncall — dropping off in 10m.

lina_oncall: thanks — leaving note: incident mitigated, currently monitoring. Will update incident ticket with timestamps and exact commands used. :white_check_mark:
